scope: scripts/pdf/copy/ms.json — all four PDFs (decision-guide, employer-funding-brief, scholarship-eligibility, working-managers-guide)
verdict_before_fixes: Facts (fee RM10,000.00, six months, six training days, three sessions, HRD Corp employer-led process, CMI certificate boundary, no-guarantee sentence) all matched en.json correctly. Register had four recurring, high-confidence defects: (1) the credential term 'projek aplikasi' used 12 times instead of the governed 'projek amali perniagaan' (owner-vocabulary-rules.md section 10 and ms-register.md item 11 both require the latter — 'aplikasi' reads as a software application, not the applied project); (2) the calque 'dalam bentuk bertulis' used 4 times instead of 'secara bertulis', paired with 'anugerah' used as a bare noun for the scholarship award (banned — should be verb 'dianugerahkan' or noun 'pemberian biasiswa'); (3) the programme name translated as 'Executive MBA dalam Kepimpinan Perniagaan Masa Hadapan' in 2 places, violating the owner decision (spec section 14, decision 1) that the programme name stays in English — 'Executive MBA on Future Ready Business Leadership' — in all three languages; (4) one instance of 'tertakluk pada' instead of the preferred collocation 'tertakluk kepada'. No instances of kamu/awak/-lah, missing meN- prefixes, English month abbreviations, 'ke atas' calque, 'pengurus bekerja' (already correctly rendered as 'pengurus yang bekerja'), 'laluan pilihan' misuse, undefined-norm qualifiers (biasanya/selalunya/kebanyakan), exclamation marks, or 'percuma' as lead word. 'disokong oleh CMI' is correct per owner decision 14.1 (overrides the general register-guide ban on that verb) and was left unchanged. CTA copy in all four documents already matched en.json meaning exactly and needed no change.
